units.summary: Adds a test helper that returns the source paths of all mocked cp calls with backslashes normalized to forward slashes. It is used by the updated tests to assert which guide files are copied.
units.headline: Add test helper listing normalized cp source paths
units.reason: New test-only helper; cannot affect production behavior and is a simple mapping over mock calls.

units.summary: Updates the upgrade prompt tests for the split guide layout (shared.md plus different-major, same-major or future-defaults guides). Existing expectations and inline snapshots are changed to the new prompt text and paths, a codemod writeFile assertion is replaced with readFile/writeFile not-called checks, and new tests cover same-major, different-major and Future Defaults guide selection.
units.headline: Tests updated for split agentic upgrade guides and prompts
units.reason: Existing expectations and snapshots were rewritten to match new behavior and one assertion on the codemod command was removed, which could hide a regression.
risk_signals: expectations changed to match new behavior
focus: Removed assertion that the written guide contains the 'upgrade 17.2.0-canary.9 --yes --skip-adoption' codemod command for canary targets is no longer checked anywhere
Inline snapshots now encode the new prompt wording; confirm it matches the intended handoff text
Same-major and future-only cases assert no writeFile/readFile, so the codemod command is not verified for those paths
